attempts.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: creature front reference for an original production model sheet. Generate one full-resolution 1536x1024 landscape PNG.
Recipe: neutral model sheet, orthographic full-body FRONT view of exactly ONE canyon wyvern; soft neutral key light from upper left, crisp opaque cool cel shadows. Flat solid light grey #E9E9EC everywhere in the background, no vignette, no scene, only a minimal soft contact mark under the two hind feet. No person, silhouette, scale bar, ground line, inset or duplicate creature.
Subject and proportions: small cliff-dwelling Hush-spawn wyvern, large-dog-sized body 1.2 m from beak tip to rump EXCLUDING its long tail; wingspan 4 m from tip to tip. Exactly two wing forelimbs and two hind legs, a bat-like flight anatomy; no separate front legs or human hands. A lean small thorax, compact pelvis and muscular digitigrade hind legs with three forward clawed toes and one rear claw each; slender neck; a narrow angular skull and a long tapered slightly hooked beaky snout. Thin uneven needle teeth visible inside a slightly parted mouth, pale cloudy non-glowing eyes. No horns, antlers, head crest, armour, feathers or mane. Small black-violet #1A1026 fissures ONLY along the wing bones leak a few sparse violet ash flakes #6B4C9A, without luminous veins across the membranes.

Clearly attached wing shoulders, elbows, wrists and membrane supports. The compact dog-sized torso must remain much smaller than the 4 m wingspan. Two hind feet support it, visible claws; tail emerges from the rump, curls to one side through the open space below a wing and ends in ONE backward hooked bone-like dark barb. Full beak, both wingtips, both feet and the entire tail tip visible. Hand-inked sparse leathery crease strokes at working joints; broad clear colour fields and a few clean hard shadow shapes, no all-over scale texture. This is a neutral design reference, no dramatic action.

Canyon wyverns: small wyverns with dog-sized bodies and 4 m wingspans, slate-grey leathery skin streaked with rust, whip tails with hooked barbs, narrow beaky snouts full of needle teeth, pale clouded eyes, violet ash leaking from cracks along the wing bones.
